Implements
[programming spec 0008](../../specs/features/002-programming/specs/0008-channel-setup-ux.md).
Source and executable tests are canonical after implementation.

## Scope Of This Plan

This plan replaces My Channels' single scrolling programming page with a
tabbed property sheet: a read-only Lineup list, a Properties dialog per show,
an Add shows dialog backed by one all-or-nothing server request, per-sitting
presets labeled by content kind, and one channel-wide Marathons control.
kraziPlan policy, rules evaluation, and reservations do not change.

## Tickets

### LIN-001: Add several shows in one request

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-19. `POST /channels/:id/programming-assignments/batch`
creates every assignment or none in one input change, with one regeneration
and one revision step; a refusal, including a member repeated within the
request, rolls back and names the assignment's `index`. The web needs no new
contract type: the request is `{ assignments: AssignmentSettings[] }` and the
response `SourceAssignment[]`, both existing; LIN-007 adds the client call.

**Goal**: The server creates several programming source assignments for one
channel all or nothing, with one regeneration.

**Scope**:

- `POST /channels/:id/programming-assignments/batch` with
  `{ assignments: AssignmentSettings[] }`, at least one.
- One `applyInputChange` call; inside it, `create` for each assignment in
  request order, appending to saved order.
- Refuse a member repeated within the request as the single create refuses an
  already-assigned member. Any refusal rolls back every assignment and names
  the assignment's index.
- Configuration and schedule revisions advance as one write.
- Web contract type for the request and response.

**Out of scope**: Any web UI (LIN-007).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**:

- Owner: backend-engineer.
- Reuse `settingsBody`, `configurationChange`, `sendCreateFailure`, and
  `create`; add only the batch loop and the within-request duplicate check.

**Verification**: Route tests prove three assignments are created in order
with one regeneration and one revision step; an unknown member, an
already-assigned member, and a member repeated in the request each create
nothing and name the index; an unknown channel returns the single create's
refusal. Run the full check list.

**Docs impact**: None.

### LIN-002: Report content kind with the stretch suggestion

**Status**

Complete on 2026-10-19. The stretch suggestion returns `contentKind` beside
`ordinaryStretch` from the one classification `suggestStretch` already runs,
so the two never disagree; the web's `StretchSuggestion` contract types it.

**Goal**: The web can tell a movie show from an episode show.

**Scope**:

- `GET /programming-assignments/stretch-suggestion` returns
  `contentKind: "movies" | "episodes" | null` beside `ordinaryStretch`, from
  the classification `suggestStretch` already reads; `null` for mixed or
  unclassified members.
- Web contract type updated.

**Out of scope**: Preset labels (LIN-005).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Owner: backend-engineer. Keep one classification
pass that yields both values, so the kind and the suggestion never disagree.

**Verification**: Route tests for a movie collection, an episode collection,
a mixed set, and unclassified items. Run the full check list.

**Docs impact**: None.

### LIN-003: Channel property sheet tabs

**Goal**: Selecting a channel shows General, Lineup, Rules, Specials, and
Preview tabs instead of one scrolling page.

**Scope**:

- General: number and name with **Apply**.
- Lineup: the existing assignment forms, add button, and marathon form, moved
  unchanged for now.
- Rules: the existing rules editor. Preview: upcoming programming and
  **Rebuild the schedule…**. Both hidden until the lineup has a show.
- Specials: the existing specials section.
- Selected tab kept while the window stays open; an empty lineup opens on
  Lineup.
- Remove the backend schedule debug line.

**Out of scope**: The lineup list and Properties dialog (LIN-004).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Owner: backend-engineer for web work. Follow the
tab markup in `collection-grid.tsx`. Every write still refreshes the lineup
and preview as `ProgrammingEditor`'s `changed` does today.

**Verification**: jsdom tests for tab switching, Rules and Preview hidden on
an empty lineup, and the debug line gone; existing channels, rules, and
specials tests pass on their new tabs. Run the full check list.

**Docs impact**: None.

### LIN-004: Lineup list and Properties dialog

**Goal**: The Lineup tab lists shows read-only and edits one show at a time in
a window dialog.

**Scope**:

- List columns: Show (members joined with `+`, truncated past two), Order,
  Per sitting (custom value in words for now), Marathons, and a **Rules only**
  badge.
- Row selection; **Properties**, **Remove** with a confirm dialog, and the row
  menu; double-click or Enter opens Properties.
- Properties dialog with **OK**, **Cancel**, **Apply**; nothing writes until
  OK or Apply. Main section: Order, per sitting through the existing stretch
  fields, **Can marathon**. Advanced section, collapsed: members (existing
  member rows), **Plays in normal rotation**, marathon length override,
  collection preview, and **Restart from the beginning…**.
- **Can marathon** derives the marathon length with `suggestMarathon` unless
  overridden.
- Remove assignment reorder controls; the web stops calling the order route.
- Regroup `apps/web/src/channels/` folders for the new lineup capability and
  update the audit exception.

**Out of scope**: Presets (LIN-005), the Marathons control and off notice
(LIN-006), Add shows and the combined picker (LIN-007). Until LIN-007, the
existing new-assignment form stays below the list.

**Blocking dependencies**: LIN-003.

**Implementation notes**: Owner: backend-engineer for web work. Reuse
`row-menu.tsx`, `row-click.ts`, and `window-dialog.tsx`. Move
`AssignmentForm`'s state into the dialog rather than keeping a second form.

**Verification**: jsdom tests: the list shows each column; Cancel discards
edits; OK and Apply save and refresh; Remove confirms and deletes; Advanced
settings round-trip; no reorder controls render. Run the full check list,
including `npm run audit:strict` for the regroup.

**Docs impact**: None.

### LIN-005: Per-sitting presets

**Goal**: Owners choose how much airs per sitting from presets worded for the
show's content.

**Scope**:

- Presets by content kind: movies `1/2/3 movies`; episodes `1 episode`,
  `3 episodes`, `~30 min`, `~1 hr`, `~2 hrs`; otherwise the same in programs.
  **Custom…** reveals the existing stretch fields.
- A saved setting matching a preset shows as that preset, any other as Custom,
  in Properties and the lineup column.
- The rule form's stretch fields use the same presets.

**Out of scope**: Marathon presets (LIN-006).

**Blocking dependencies**: LIN-002, LIN-004.

**Implementation notes**: Owner: backend-engineer for web work. One preset
component replaces direct `StretchFields` use in Properties and the rule form;
`StretchFields` stays as its Custom body.

**Verification**: jsdom tests: a movie show offers movie presets and an
episode show episode presets; a custom range round-trips as Custom; the rule
form saves a preset override. Run the full check list.

**Docs impact**: None.

### LIN-006: One Marathons control

**Goal**: Marathon chance and cooldown are set in one place, and turning on a
show's marathons never silently does nothing.

**Scope**:

- Lineup footer control: Off (0%), Occasional (10%, 2 rounds), Frequent (25%,
  1 round), **Custom…** dialog with the two fields. Presets save immediately;
  unmatched saved values show as Custom. Disabled with **No show can marathon
  yet.** when no show can.
- In Properties, checking **Can marathon** while channel marathons are off
  shows **Marathons are off for this channel.** with **Turn on occasional
  marathons**, which saves the channel setting immediately and says so.
  Saving the show never changes channel settings.
- Lineup rows read `up to 3 hrs (off)` while channel marathons are off.
- Remove `marathon-settings-form.tsx`.

**Out of scope**: Any change to marathon selection policy.

**Blocking dependencies**: LIN-004.

**Implementation notes**: Owner: backend-engineer for web work. Reuse the
marathon settings route as it stands.

**Verification**: jsdom tests for each preset save, Custom round-trip, the
disabled state, the off notice and its button, OK not touching channel
settings, and the `(off)` marker. Run the full check list.

**Docs impact**: None.

### LIN-007: Add shows dialog

**Goal**: Owners set up a channel by picking several shows at once.

**Scope**:

- **Add shows…** window dialog with one search over collections and single
  items, labeled by kind, multi-select.
- Each pick takes the suggested per sitting; a pick with no suggestion shows
  an inline preset choice before **Add** is enabled. Marathons off.
- **Add** sends one LIN-001 batch request; on failure nothing is added, the
  dialog keeps its picks and names the rejected show.
- Advanced members in Properties use the same combined picker, replacing the
  source-type select.
- Remove the interim new-assignment form.

**Out of scope**: Owner-given show names; server-side combined search.

**Blocking dependencies**: LIN-001, LIN-004, LIN-005.

**Implementation notes**: Owner: backend-engineer for web work. Compose
`MediaItemPicker`'s search with the collection list; do not add a server
search route.

**Verification**: jsdom tests: three picks become three shows in one request;
a pick without a suggestion blocks Add until chosen; a refused batch adds
nothing and names the show; Advanced members add an item and a collection
through the combined picker. Run the full check list.

**Docs impact**: None.
